senses.gloss:
कॢप् कॢप्, i. 1, कल्प, Ātm.
 1. To prosper, Man. 4, 15.
 2. To be fit, to be qualified for; with the loc. Rām. 2, 62, 26 Gorr.; 5, 37, 30; with the dat. Man. 3, 266; to become qualified, Man. 7, 22; Megh. 56 (प्राप्तये, to attain).
 3. To fall to one's lot, Bhāg. P. 3, 16, 12.
 4. To serve (with the dat.), Man. 8, 353.
 5. To resolve upon, Pañc. 150, 24.
 6. To create, Bhāg. P. 3, 7, 25.
 क्लिप्त,
 1. Well arranged, MBh. 3, 790.
 2. Fixed, Man. 3, 69.
 3. Made, Bhāg. P. 6, 10, 32.
 --Comp.
 --Caus., कल्पय, Par., Ātm.
 1. To put in suitable order.
 कल्पित, Fixed in proportion, Yājñ. 2, 244.
 प्रथम-कल्पित, put at the head, Man. 9, 166.
 2. To make fit for something, MBh. 8, 9912.
 3. To approve, Rām. 2, 61, 17.
 4. To show, MBh. 1, 58.
 6. To design, Rām. 2, 52, 100; to determine, Man. 7, 125; Daśak. in Chr. 189, 1.
 7. To consider, Rām. 2, 23, 33.
 8. To form, Ragh. 8, 46; Bhāg. P. 8, 9, 26; to make, Rām. 2, 98, 29; MBh. 1, 700 [] (वृत्तिम्, To live on, with the instr.).
 9. To create, Man. 5, 28; Bhāg. P. 2, 5, 42.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, Caus., श्रद्धाम्, To give faith, Rām. 5, 56, 15.
 अनुकल्पित, Accompanied, MBh. 13, 2150.
 --With समनु सम्-अनु, Caus., To assume, MBh. 3, 9964.
 --With अभि अभि, Caus., To arrange, Rām. 2, 54, 17.
 --With अव अव, To be fit (with the dat.), Bhāg. P. 6, 7, 18.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To be suitable, Bhāg. P. 6, 18, 42.
 2. To serve, Rām. 5, 25, 21.
 उपकॢप्त,
 1. Prepared for use, Man. 8, 333; prepared, MBh. 1, 4098.
 2. Produced, Bhāg. P. 5, 16, 2.
 --Caus.
 1. To prepare, Rām. 1, 12, 29.
 2. To fit out, MBh. 1, 4098.
 3. To design for (with the dat.), Yājñ. 1, 109.
 4. To place, Bhāg. P. 5, 23, 5; 1, 9, 32.
 5. To communicate, Bhāg. P. 5, 3, 9.
 --With समुप सम्-उप, Caus. To prepare, Rām. 2, 50, 29.
 --With परि परि, परिकॢप्त, Existing, MBh. 13, 2831.
 --Caus.
 1. To decide, Man. 12, 110.
 2. To determine, MBh. 13, 2689.
 3. To perform, Yājñ. 1, 346.
 4. To make, Kathās. 15, 173; Man. 9, 152 (दशधा, To distribute into ten parts).
 5. To invite, MBh. 13, 1596.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रकॢप्त, Prepared, Kathās. 18, 366.
 --Caus.
 1. To prepare, 3, 264.
 2. To further, Rām. 2, 31, 24.
 3. To allot, Man. 7, 135.
 4. To establish, Man. 8, 46.
 5. To design, Bhāg. P. 4, 18, 20.
 6. To make, Nal. 25, 5; Amar. 73 (अश्रु, To shed tears).
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, Caus. To ordain, MBh. 3, 14110.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To change, MBh. 3, 697.
 2. To be doubtful, Pañc. i. d. 385; to doubt, Pañc. i. d. 87.
 --Caus.
 1. To prepare in a different way, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 38.
 2. To devise, Śāk. d. 51.
 3. [] To doubt, Prab. 106, 7.
 4. To presume, Pañc. iv. d. 62.
 --With सम् सम्, To desire; अ-संकॢप्त, Not desired, MBh. 14, 1277.
 --Caus.
 1. To desire, Man. 2, 5.
 2. To determine, MBh. 14, 4349.
 3. To fancy, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 1.
 4. To perform obsequies, Rām. 2, 72, 53.
 --With उपसम् उप-सम्, उपसंकॢप्त, Put on, Bhāg. P. 4, 9, 54.
 --Caus. To place, MBh. 16, 199.
 --Cf. Lat. corpus.

कॢप्ति कॢप् + ति, f. Causing, Rājat. 5, 463.
 --Comp.
कॢप्त-हर्म्य-स्थल कॢप्त-हर्म्य-स्थल, adj., f. ली, of which the ground of the palaces was made, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 15.
